requirements.condition: When encoding or decoding the experimental MINFO RDATA format.
requirements.required_behavior: Represent the RDATA as an RMAILBX field followed by an EMAILBX field.
requirements.why_checkable: The serializer and parser field layout can be checked for the two fields and their order.

requirements.quote:
RMAILBX         A <domain-name> which specifies a mailbox which is
                responsible for the mailing list or mailbox.
requirements.condition: When encoding or decoding RMAILBX in an experimental MINFO record.
requirements.required_behavior: Encode and interpret RMAILBX as a domain name.
requirements.why_checkable: The field codec can be inspected and exercised with domain-name encodings.

requirements.quote:
RMAILBX         A <domain-name> which specifies a mailbox which is
                responsible for the mailing list or mailbox.  If this
                domain name names the root, the owner of the MINFO RR is
                responsible for itself.
requirements.condition: When interpreting an experimental MINFO record whose RMAILBX does not name the root.
requirements.required_behavior: Interpret RMAILBX as the mailbox responsible for the mailing list or mailbox.
requirements.why_checkable: The RMAILBX value can be compared with the responsible-mailbox value exposed to consumers.

requirements.quote:
RMAILBX         A <domain-name> which specifies a mailbox which is
                responsible for the mailing list or mailbox.  If this
                domain name names the root, the owner of the MINFO RR is
                responsible for itself.
requirements.condition: When RMAILBX in an experimental MINFO record names the root.
requirements.required_behavior: Interpret the owner of the MINFO RR as responsible for itself.
requirements.why_checkable: A root-valued RMAILBX supplies a concrete input for checking the responsible-mailbox interpretation.

requirements.quote:
EMAILBX         A <domain-name> which specifies a mailbox which is to
                receive error messages related to the mailing list or
                mailbox specified by the owner of the MINFO RR (similar
                to the ERRORS-TO: field which has been proposed).
requirements.condition: When encoding or decoding EMAILBX in an experimental MINFO record.
requirements.required_behavior: Encode and interpret EMAILBX as a domain name.
requirements.why_checkable: The EMAILBX codec can be inspected and exercised with domain-name encodings.

requirements.quote:
EMAILBX         A <domain-name> which specifies a mailbox which is to
                receive error messages related to the mailing list or
                mailbox specified by the owner of the MINFO RR (similar
                to the ERRORS-TO: field which has been proposed).  If
                this domain name names the root, errors should be
                returned to the sender of the message.
requirements.condition: When using an experimental MINFO record whose EMAILBX does not name the root to determine where related error messages are sent.
requirements.required_behavior: Use the mailbox specified by EMAILBX as the recipient of error messages concerning the mailing list or mailbox named by the MINFO RR owner.
requirements.why_checkable: A non-root EMAILBX and an error concerning the owner identify a concrete recipient-selection check.

requirements.quote:
EMAILBX         A <domain-name> which specifies a mailbox which is to
                receive error messages related to the mailing list or
                mailbox specified by the owner of the MINFO RR (similar
                to the ERRORS-TO: field which has been proposed).  If
                this domain name names the root, errors should be
                returned to the sender of the message.
requirements.condition: When EMAILBX in an experimental MINFO record names the root and an error concerns the mailing list or mailbox named by the RR owner.
requirements.required_behavior: Errors should be returned to the sender of the message; this is advisory behavior.
requirements.why_checkable: A root-valued EMAILBX gives a concrete case for checking the recommended error recipient.

requirements.quote: MINFO records cause no additional section processing.
requirements.condition: When processing an experimental MINFO record.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Perform additional section processing as a consequence of the MINFO record.
requirements.why_checkable: Response construction can be checked for additional-section processing triggered by MINFO.

requirements.quote:
Although these
records can be associated with a simple mailbox, they are usually used
with a mailing list.
requirements.condition: When associating an experimental MINFO record with an owner.
requirements.required_behavior: The record may be associated with a simple mailbox.
requirements.why_checkable: A simple-mailbox owner provides a concrete case for checking the permitted record association.
